title: prefill/decoding: chunked prefill + speculative prefill + stage-overlap scheduling
author: Ethan Chung
description: Motivation: reduce end-to-end latency and GPU tail latency for mixed prefill+decode workloads (chat + streaming) by overlapping prefill and decode stages, supporting chunked prefill to fit GPU memory and network windows, and enabling speculative prefill for long-prefix requests. This PR combines three related optimizations: 1) stage overlap scheduling so prefill and decode can run concurrently on different GPUs/streams when model/kv cache compatibility allows, 2) chunked prefill which splits very large prefill sequences into smaller KV-capable chunks to improve memory locality and avoid monolithic kernel spikes, and 3) speculative prefill where we pre-compute likely KV states for upcoming chunks based on prefix heuristics and early tokens to reduce decode stalls. Design summary: single scheduling layer change adds a lightweight pipeline stage manager that tracks compatible model variants and KV cache shapes; scheduler can run prefill chunks on dedicated streams and then allow decode to start on earlier chunks while later chunks are finalizing. Chunked prefill serializes attention/key-value writes in 1280-token (configurable) windows; we added a chunk-merging pass to preserve attention semantics. Speculative prefill uses a probabilistic prefix sampler (configurable threshold) and keeps speculative KV versions; when speculation is wrong we fast-rollback by replaying only the delta tokens. Benchmarks: end-to-end latency improvements on chat benchmark with mixed prefix lengths: median latency -12%, p95 -22%, GPU utilization improved by 18% for 16 GPU cluster with mixed batch sizes. Long-prefill-heavy tails (>=4k tokens) show up to 35% improvement in token throughput when chunking is enabled compared to baseline monolithic prefill. Speculative prefill reduces stalls for streaming workloads with predictable prefixes (templated prompts) and shows 8-10% additional p95 improvement in those scenarios. Compatibility and safety: fallback to single-stage prefill+decode when model variant doesn't support chunked KV writes or when KV synchronization cannot be guaranteed. Speculative mode is opt-in via request flag and gated by a global feature flag; we add metrics for speculation hit/miss and rollback count to track correctness impact. Changes: runtime scheduler, kv cache interfaces, prefill and decode execution paths, tests and perf harness scripts, and docs for new request flags and knobs. See changed_files for specifics. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-4521, ENG-4602) [x] unit tests for scheduler transitions [x] integration tests for chunked prefill semantics [x] perf harness runs attached [x] feature gated + telemetry added [x] documented API flag and config knobs.
